regressionSourceHashAuthority: The verified clarification-dialogue-v4 archived producer plan, indexed in evidence-retention.md. The older policy lock uses inherited hashes; actual raw role/content hashes for all 24 cases were verified against the v4 producer before live regression.
interpretation: Derived dialogues over consumed LongMemEval-S histories, not an independent official score. Proposed local reminders/aliases are controlled test dialogue, not facts claimed to originate in the benchmark. Counts/clauses are evaluated by complete answer audit; literal substring checks are secondary signals.

conditions.current: One active input, complete pending dialogue when present.
conditions.retain-5: Last five eligible source messages including active input, union complete pending dialogue. Exclude retained messages before both search legs and local budgeting.

controlledPrefixes: Identical frozen user/assistant prefixes are produced through native generation with controlled schema responses. New ordinary prefixes are answered; old regressions are needs_clarification. Final replies use live Sol, and no initial classification-quality claim is made.
